videos.title: GTA 6's Album Just Broke a Spotify Record 🎶 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA VI: The Album reportedly racked up 29.85 million Spotify streams on day one, the biggest opening day ever for a soundtrack, and Justice's "Flower in a Hurricane" reportedly topped Spotify's daily global chart. Spotify hasn't published official figures; Justice's original score is still due Dec 11.

Sources: Push Square, Pop Base, InMusic, VGTimes, Rockstar Games

videos.title: GTA 6 Players Found a Hidden First-Person View 👀 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 launched without a first-person mode, but players found an unofficial camera glitch that gives a first-person view while standing, aiming scoped weapons and driving. It's buggy, cutscenes stay third-person, and Rockstar could patch it.

videos.title: That GTA 6 'Xbox Build' Leak: What's Real ⚠️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Leaker Cyberleek claims to have posted a ~209GB GTA 6 Xbox build with the main executable held back and tied to a meme coin. The files are unverified, Rockstar and Take-Two haven't commented, and fake game downloads are a common malware trap. GTA 6 is on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, with no PC date announced.

Sources: PC Gamer, Kotaku, VGC, VideoCardz, TweakTown
